What is omawrite?

Omawrite is a minimalist Markdown writing app built with Qt Quick, aimed at distraction-free drafting rather than full document editing. Markdown syntax stays visible but fades visually as you type, it follows your system's light or dark theme automatically, and it recovers unsaved drafts after a crash and warns you before an external edit would overwrite your work. It covers the basics newcomers expect: open/save/save-as through native file pickers, find and replace, and keyboard shortcuts for bold, italic, and links.

Install omawrite on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add omawrite
